archive.catalogue_description: Here comes my second map! It is called Wooden Keep and it takes place in recently USA army captured military warehouse of nazis. Four heroes of alternate universe are teleported to this Wooden Keep after Der Riese. There they must make their last stand against the undead. DOWNLOAD LINK (you also need T4M & it properly installed in right folder) T4M Features 4 original perks Pack A Punch Machine Mystery Box Wall Buys Zombies Hellhounds (in own rounds) Soldier Boys (the same bosses from my Stone Domain map. They have at start lesser health than pigment boys, but after round 10 they pretty much have already larger health than Pigment Boys. 3 will spawn every round.) Pigment Boys (even tougher bosses than Soldier Boys and have pink/yellow odd faces, Their health is static,but very large. Normal zombies will reach their health and go beyond around Round 40. One will spawn in every two round and first one will spawn in round 2. ) Only 4 Windows In The Map, making it epic survival fight!!!!!!! No buyable ending as was the case with Stone Domain too devmap nazi_zombie_woodenkeep to be typed on console to access the map solo after launching the mod and in cooperative select it from game settings after launching the mod.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
